title: SE-Search: Self-Evolving Search Agent via Memory and Dense Reward
authors: Jian Li; Yizhang Jin; Dongqi Liu; Hang Ding; Jiafu Wu; Dongsheng Chen; Yunhang Shen; Yulei Qin; Ying Tai; Chengjie Wang; Xiaotong Yuan; Yabiao Wang
why_relevant: Proposes a search agent that filters noisy retrieved documents via memory purification and uses dense rewards to control when/what to search, addressing noisy retrieval and retrieval control.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on agent training rather than systematic robustness analysis; does not address conflict, adversarial, or calibration of uncertainty.
